composition_summary: Preserved the supplied user message unchanged. Drafted one class-22 PythonCode candidate pc-classify-value with name/description/content only. The body is a module-scope if/else result assignment (no return, no imports, no host, no I/O): it reads value via inputs.get('value') so missing and null stay distinct, validates exact integer semantics (rejecting bool and floats), enforces the 0..10 inclusive range, and returns {state, value} for all four outcomes — missing, null, value, invalid — with no defaults or coercion. This is an unapproved offline-design draft; it does not submit, validate, approve or activate anything, and no UUID was allocated.

payload.name: pc-classify-value
payload.description: Classify an optional raw value while preserving the distinction between missing and null. Returns {state, value}: 'missing' when the key is absent, 'null' when explicitly null, 'value' for an exact integer in 0..10 inclusive, and 'invalid' for any other value. No defaults, coercion, exceptions, imports, host calls or I/O.
